metadata.question: Does the water in the southeastern coast of Guishan Island (24.83594812988359, 121.96499287870442) exhibit a lighter blue coloration than the northwestern coastal waters (24.84607374884142, 121.93452298429524) on September 29, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: Sentinel-2 L2A (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) over 2021-09-29.
- If empty, widen to ±3 days.
- If still empty, fallback to Sentinel-2 TOA with QA60 cloud mask and NDWI water mask; if empty then Landsat 8 L2 ±3 days.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- We need water color, so mask clouds and retain only water.
- S2_SR: SCL==6 for water, exclude SCL 3,8,9,10.
- S2_TOA: QA60 clouds/cirrus + NDWI > 0.
- L8 L2: QA_PIXEL clouds/shadows/cirrus + NDWI > 0.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after attempts => C1.
- If valid pixel counts in any ROI == 0 after masking => C2.
- If computed means are null/NaN/out of [0,1] => C3.
- Otherwise compare mean Blue reflectance (threshold 0.005) to decide A (Yes) or B (No).
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const ptSE = ee.Geometry.Point([121.96499287870442, 24.83594812988359]);
    const ptNW = ee.Geometry.Point([121.93452298429524, 24.84607374884142]);
    const roiSE = ptSE.buffer(1500);  // large enough for 1000 m scale sampling
    const roiNW = ptNW.buffer(1500);
    const studyArea = roiSE.union(roiNW);
    const dateCenter = '2021-09-29';
    const dayStart = ee.Date(dateCenter);
    const dayEnd = dayStart.advance(1, 'day');
    const widenStart = dayStart.advance(-3, 'day');
    const widenEnd = dayStart.advance(3, 'day');

    // 2. Helpers
    function getInfoAsync(obj) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
      });
    }

    // Prepare S2 SR
    function s2srProcessed(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterBounds(studyArea)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
      const mapped = col.map(function(img) {
        const scl = img.select('SCL');
        const water = scl.eq(6);
        const clouds = scl.eq(3).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)).or(scl.eq(10));
        const mask = water.and(clouds.not());
        const vis = img.select(['B2','B3','B4']).multiply(0.0001).rename(['blue','green','red']);
        const I = vis.expression('(b("blue")+b("green")+b("red"))/3').rename('I');
        return vis.addBands(I).updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
      });
      return mapped;
    }

    // Prepare S2 TOA
    function s2toaProcessed(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterBounds(studyArea)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
      const mapped = col.map(function(img) {
        const qa = img.select('QA60');
        const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0);
        const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0);
        const cloudMask = cloud.or(cirrus).not();
        const vis = img.select(['B2','B3','B4']).rename(['blue','green','red']); // already scaled (0-1)
        const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3','B8']).rename('ndwi');
        const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0);
        const I = vis.expression('(b("blue")+b("green")+b("red"))/3').rename('I');
        return vis.addBands(I).updateMask(cloudMask).updateMask(waterMask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
      });
      return mapped;
    }

    // Prepare Landsat 8 L2
    function l8Processed(start, end) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(studyArea)
        .filterDate(start, end);
      const mapped = col.map(function(img) {
        const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))     // Cloud shadow
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0));    // Cirrus
        const scale = 0.0000275;
        const offset = -0.2;
        const blue = img.select('SR_B2').multiply(scale).add(offset).rename('blue');
        const green = img.select('SR_B3').multiply(scale).add(offset).rename('green');
        const red = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(scale).add(offset).rename('red');
        const ndwi = green.subtract(img.select('SR_B5').multiply(scale).add(offset))
                      .divide(green.add(img.select('SR_B5').multiply(scale).add(offset))).rename('ndwi');
        const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0);
        const vis = ee.Image.cat([blue, green, red]);
        const I = vis.expression('(b("blue")+b("green")+b("red"))/3').rename('I');
        return vis.addBands(I).updateMask(mask).updateMask(waterMask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
      });
      return mapped;
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Check
    let chosen = null;
    let dataset = '';
    let dateStr = '';
    let colSize = 0;

    const s2srDay = s2srProcessed(dayStart, dayEnd);
    const s2srDaySize = await getInfoAsync(s2srDay.size());
    if (s2srDaySize > 0) {
      chosen = s2srDay.median();
      dataset = 'S2_SR (day)';
      dateStr = `${await getInfoAsync(dayStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}`;
      colSize = s2srDaySize;
    } else {
      const s2srWide = s2srProcessed(widenStart, widenEnd);
      const s2srWideSize = await getInfoAsync(s2srWide.size());
      if (s2srWideSize > 0) {
        chosen = s2srWide.median();
        dataset = 'S2_SR (±3d)';
        dateStr = `${await getInfoAsync(widenStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}..${await getInfoAsync(widenEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}`;
        colSize = s2srWideSize;
      } else {
        const s2toaWide = s2toaProcessed(widenStart, widenEnd);
        const s2toaSize = await getInfoAsync(s2toaWide.size());
        if (s2toaSize > 0) {
          chosen = s2toaWide.median();
          dataset = 'S2_TOA (±3d)';
          dateStr = `${await getInfoAsync(widenStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}..${await getInfoAsync(widenEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}`;
          colSize = s2toaSize;
        } else {
          const l8Wide = l8Processed(widenStart, widenEnd);
          const l8Size = await getInfoAsync(l8Wide.size());
          if (l8Size > 0) {
            chosen = l8Wide.median();
            dataset = 'Landsat 8 L2 (±3d)';
            dateStr = `${await getInfoAsync(widenStart.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}..${await getInfoAsync(widenEnd.format('YYYY-MM-dd'))}`;
            colSize = l8Size;
          } else {
            console.log('No images found across S2_SR day/±3d, S2_TOA ±3d, and L8 ±3d.');
            console.log('C1');
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Processing & Pixel counts
    const scale = 1000; // per requirement
    const totalSE = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roiSE, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('const');
    const totalNW = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roiNW, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('const');

    const countSE = chosen.select('blue').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roiSE, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('blue');
    const countNW = chosen.select('blue').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roiNW, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('blue');

    const blueSE = chosen.select('blue').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roiSE, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('blue');
    const blueNW = chosen.select('blue').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roiNW, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('blue');

    const ISE = chosen.select('I').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roiSE, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('I');
    const INW = chosen.select('I').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roiNW, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('I');

    const results = await getInfoAsync(ee.Dictionary({
      dataset: dataset,
      dateStr: dateStr,
      colSize: colSize,
      totalSE: totalSE, totalNW: totalNW,
      countSE: countSE, countNW: countNW,
      blueSE: blueSE, blueNW: blueNW,
      ISE: ISE, INW: INW
    }));

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Using: ${results.dataset}; Date: ${results.dateStr}; Images: ${results.colSize}`);
    const validSE = results.countSE || 0;
    const validNW = results.countNW || 0;
    const totSE = results.totalSE || 0;
    const totNW = results.totalNW || 0;

    if (validSE === 0 || validNW === 0) {
      console.log(`SE pixels: ${validSE}/${totSE} valid; NW pixels: ${validNW}/${totNW} valid`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const bSE = results.blueSE;
    const bNW = results.blueNW;
    const iSE = results.ISE;
    const iNW = results.INW;

    const anyNull = (bSE === null || bNW === null || iSE === null || iNW === null);
    const anyNaN = (isNaN(bSE) || isNaN(bNW) || isNaN(iSE) || isNaN(iNW));
    const outOfRange = (bSE < 0 || bSE > 1 || bNW < 0 || bNW > 1);
    if (anyNull || anyNaN || outOfRange) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const maskOutSE = totSE > 0 ? (100 * (1 - validSE / totSE)) : null;
    const maskOutNW = totNW > 0 ? (100 * (1 - validNW / totNW)) : null;

    console.log(`SE Valid: ${validSE}/${totSE} (mask-out ${(maskOutSE!==null?maskOutSE.toFixed(1):'NA')}%), Blue: ${bSE.toFixed(4)}, I: ${iSE.toFixed(4)}`);
    console.log(`NW Valid: ${validNW}/${totNW} (mask-out ${(maskOutNW!==null?maskOutNW.toFixed(1):'NA')}%), Blue: ${bNW.toFixed(4)}, I: ${iNW.toFixed(4)}`);

    const deltaBlue = bSE - bNW;
    console.log(`ΔBlue (SE-NW): ${deltaBlue.toFixed(4)}`);
    const thresh = 0.005; // 0.5% reflectance threshold
    if (deltaBlue > thresh) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
